items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Then in going on through the sixties, the trombone section was pretty stable there. It was you, and Chuck Connors, and Buster Cooper steadily through -- almost through the end of '69. Yes.

ctx.x: Who was in the trombone section when

According to a chart I have here prepared by a Frenchman by the name of Jean Portier which is reasonably accurate, it says when you returned to the band in 1960 the other two trombone players were Mitchell Booty Wood D'Letwood and Britt Woodman?
